## What's the use case

What are you trying to accomplish? A real-world scenario, not a generic capability.

## How it would behave

The smallest user-visible change that solves it.

## Why PMB and not something else

If a different tool already does this well, why use PMB instead?

## Out-of-scope checklist

PMB will not grow:
- multi-user / multi-device sync
- a new web frontend (the dashboard stays vanilla HTML/JS)
- LLM provider integrations beyond Anthropic + OpenAI + Ollama
- "agent-like" features that belong in the agent, not in the memory layer

If your idea touches any of these, the PR will probably be declined — open an issue first to discuss.
